profile.name: Rishav Mishra
profile.title: Content Strategist and Growth
profile.headline: I write content that gets read, remembered, and shared.
profile.bio: Hey, I'm Rishav. I help founders, creators, and growing companies turn their ideas into clear, engaging content that stops people from scrolling. No generic AI fluff, no empty jargon. Just deep research, sharp hooks, and real stories that build genuine trust and grow audiences.
profile.extendedBio: Most company content is boring because it sounds like everyone else. I take complex industry topics, reports, and founder experiences and turn them into sharp posts, breakdown essays, and clear playbooks people actually want to read. I've scaled reach to over 1.1M+ impressions for founders, grown followings 3.44×, and managed community operations for companies like Notion.
profile.funQuote: Good content gives information. Great content shifts how you see the problem.

highlightMetrics.label: Audience Lift
highlightMetrics.detail: Twitter / X growth at Levo in 90 days

frameworks.title: Content Creation & Architecture
frameworks.tagline: How I research, outline, write, and polish content that actually performs
frameworks.summary: The exact 5-step process I use to write high-engagement founder breakdowns, thought leadership posts, and teardowns.

steps.title: Find Trending Signals
steps.description: Scan industry conversations, reports, and breaking news to uncover what operators are actively debating.

breakdown.overview: I monitor real-time industry discussions, company earnings reports, and breaking product shifts on Perplexity and primary source feeds.
keyActions: Run query matrices across founder communities and industry news reports.
Identify newly released industry benchmarks and unexpected percentage spikes.
Flag unanswered debates where conventional wisdom is being questioned.

toolsApplied.name: Perplexity AI
toolsApplied.purpose: Trend analysis & primary source citation scanning

toolsApplied.name: Google Scholar
toolsApplied.purpose: Peer-reviewed research and validated data points

breakdown.decisionRule: A high-search volume topic is worthless if it doesn't solve a real problem for the target audience.
breakdown.outputArtifact: A curated list of 5-7 raw topic candidates with primary reference links.

steps.title: Manual ICP Filter
steps.description: Filter topics strictly against the client's direct operating experience and target audience priorities.

breakdown.overview: I run each candidate topic through a 3-point filter: Does the client have firsthand authority on this? Does the reader care? Can we provide a non-obvious solution?
keyActions: Eliminate generic trendjacking that doesn't build long-term authority.
Check if the topic speaks directly to decision-makers (Founders, Heads of Ops, Directors).
Match the topic with specific anecdotal lessons from the client's background.

toolsApplied.name: ICP Rubric
toolsApplied.purpose: Audience relevance checklist and persona alignment

toolsApplied.name: Founder Interview
toolsApplied.purpose: Extracting direct operational anecdotes and viewpoints

breakdown.decisionRule: If anyone on the internet could have written it, it's not ready. It must sound uniquely grounded in the client's firsthand point of view.
breakdown.outputArtifact: 1 shortlisted topic with an agreed-upon core angle.

steps.title: Find the Best Angle
steps.description: Brainstorm 5 distinct narrative angles (contrarian, teardown, case study, frameworks, data story) before writing a single sentence.

breakdown.overview: I test multiple angles to find the most gripping narrative hook before drafting.
keyActions: Generate 5 distinct angles: Contrarian, Data Breakdown, Forensic Case Study, Playbook, Personal Anecdote.
Evaluate each angle for shareability and comment provocation.
Select the single most compelling hook that promises immediate, tangible value.

toolsApplied.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
toolsApplied.purpose: Angle stress-testing and counter-perspective simulation

toolsApplied.name: Angle Matrix Sheet
toolsApplied.purpose: Scoring curiosity vs credibility for each angle

breakdown.decisionRule: The best angle is always the one that makes the reader re-examine an everyday belief they took for granted.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Selected core angle with primary thesis statement and supporting outline.

steps.title: Write the 6-Part Anatomy
steps.description: Structure the draft across 6 core components: Hook, Stakes, Core Insight, Case Evidence, Visual Diagram, and Actionable Callout.

breakdown.overview: Every breakdown follows a battle-tested 6-part architecture engineered for maximum retention, reader clarity, and effortless scanning.
keyActions: Draft Part 1 (The Hook): A 2-line tension point that stops the feed scroll.
Draft Part 2 (The Stakes): Explain why this matters right now to the reader.
Draft Part 3 (Core Insight): Unpack the fundamental lesson or strategic shift.
Draft Part 4 (Case Evidence): Provide real metrics, brand names, and timelines.
Draft Part 5 (Visual Diagram): Generate an infographic using Napkin AI.
Draft Part 6 (Actionable Callout): Give a memorable closing lesson or question.

toolsApplied.name: Notion Draft Engine
toolsApplied.purpose: Distraction-free Markdown drafting and revisions

toolsApplied.name: Napkin AI
toolsApplied.purpose: Generating clean vector diagrams and flowcharts in seconds

breakdown.decisionRule: Never publish a wall of unbroken text. High retention requires rhythm: short sentences, punchy paragraphs, and clear subheadings.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Complete 6-part draft including visual diagram and reference data.

anatomyBlocks.name: The Hook
anatomyBlocks.description: The first 2 lines. Creates curiosity and breaks expectations without clickbait.

anatomyBlocks.name: The Stakes
anatomyBlocks.description: Quickly explains why ignoring this costs money, time, or growth.

anatomyBlocks.name: Core Insight
anatomyBlocks.description: Explains the non-obvious shift or strategy in clear, straightforward terms.

anatomyBlocks.name: Case Evidence
anatomyBlocks.description: Real numbers, dates, and examples that prove the strategy works in practice.

anatomyBlocks.name: Visual Diagram
anatomyBlocks.description: A clean flowchart or breakdown generated via Napkin AI for easy visual digestion.

anatomyBlocks.name: Actionable Callout
anatomyBlocks.description: A clear takeaway, question, or next step that encourages discussion in the comments.

steps.title: Edit for Rhythm & Flow
steps.description: Read out loud to strip buzzwords, vary sentence cadence, ensure natural human phrasing, and verify every number.

breakdown.overview: The difference between generic AI text and high-converting writing is the final edit. I read every line out loud to ensure it sounds like a real operator speaking.
keyActions: Strip buzzwords ('delve', 'testament', 'revolutionize', 'unleash', 'crucial').
Alternate between short, punchy statements and descriptive compound sentences.
Fact-check every single metric, company valuation, and date against original sources.

toolsApplied.name: Hemingway Editor
toolsApplied.purpose: Monitoring sentence length and grade-level readability

toolsApplied.name: Out-Loud Reading Check
toolsApplied.purpose: Ensuring smooth spoken cadence and zero awkward transitions

breakdown.decisionRule: If you wouldn't say it over coffee with a smart founder, delete it from the draft.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Publication-ready draft verified for voice, accuracy, and format.

frameworks.title: Brand Positioning & Narrative
frameworks.tagline: Turning founder experience into an undeniable category advantage
frameworks.summary: How I uncover a founder's unique advantage, clarify their point of view, and build category authority.

steps.title: Founder Story Extraction
steps.description: Interview the founder to capture their unique operating insights, contrarian beliefs, and past career pivot moments.

breakdown.overview: I conduct a structured 45-minute story interview to uncover the founder's genuine viewpoints, hard-won lessons, and behind-the-scenes wins.
keyActions: Ask about the hardest decisions, biggest mistakes, and counter-intuitive lessons learned.
Identify the 3 core themes the founder can speak on with true authority.
Record exact voice phrases, idioms, and natural storytelling cadence.

toolsApplied.name: Otter.ai / Whisper
toolsApplied.purpose: High-accuracy transcription of founder voice notes

toolsApplied.name: Founder Voice Sheet
toolsApplied.purpose: Documenting signature tone, viewpoints, and banned words

breakdown.decisionRule: Authenticity cannot be faked. True brand authority comes from real operating scar tissue and genuine lessons.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Founder Voice Guide & 10+ core story seeds.

steps.title: Category & Rival Mapping
steps.description: Analyze what competitors and peers are writing about to find the whitespace they are completely missing.

breakdown.overview: We map competitor messaging to identify where the market is saturated and where white space exists.
keyActions: Audit top 5 competitor accounts for topic frequency and comment sentiment.
Identify tired, repetitive tropes the audience is visibly tired of reading.
Stake out 2-3 contrarian territory pillars where our client has a clear advantage.

toolsApplied.name: Competitor Analysis Sheet
toolsApplied.purpose: Auditing competitor reach, topics, and comment sentiment

toolsApplied.name: Whitespace Grid
toolsApplied.purpose: Plotting neglected audience pain points against market noise

breakdown.decisionRule: Never compete on volume where others have a head start. Compete on depth, point of view, and clearer frameworks.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Category Whitespace Map & Core Positioning Thesis.

steps.title: Core Content Pillars
steps.description: Build a repeatable 3-pillar content engine (Industry Insights, Founder Journey, Actionable Playbooks).

breakdown.overview: We establish a balanced content diet that keeps the audience educated, inspired, and engaged without feeling sold to.
keyActions: Pillar 1 (40%): Deep Industry Insights & Market Breakdowns.
Pillar 2 (35%): Actionable Step-by-Step Playbooks and Frameworks.
Pillar 3 (25%): Behind-the-Scenes Founder Lessons & Culture.

toolsApplied.name: Pillar Allocation Matrix
toolsApplied.purpose: Balancing weekly output across authority, utility, and personality

toolsApplied.name: Idea Generation Board
toolsApplied.purpose: Categorizing raw ideas under their respective pillar

breakdown.decisionRule: Consistency comes from clarity. When you know your 3 pillars, you never sit down wondering what to write about.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Brand Content Architecture Guide with 30-day topic roadmap.

steps.title: Visual Identity in Text
steps.description: Establish signature formatting styles, visual diagram themes, and recurring weekly series formats.

breakdown.overview: Creating an unmistakable visual signature in the feed through consistent diagram design, formatting, and recurring weekly columns.
keyActions: Define brand color palette and typography rules for Napkin AI diagrams.
Establish recurring series (e.g. 'Monday Teardown', 'Friday Playbook').
Set structural formatting rules for hooks, lists, quotes, and takeaways.

toolsApplied.name: Diagram Theme Presets
toolsApplied.purpose: Pre-configured Napkin AI brand styling

toolsApplied.name: Formatting SOP
toolsApplied.purpose: Rules on whitespace, bullet styling, and bolding for scanning

breakdown.decisionRule: Make your posts recognizable before the reader even checks the author name.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Visual Style Kit & Template Swipe File.

frameworks.title: Growth & Multi-Channel Distribution
frameworks.tagline: Multiplying reach across LinkedIn, Twitter/X, newsletters, and communities
frameworks.summary: A systematic playbook to turn 1 deep-dive asset into 10+ high-converting derivative formats across platforms.

steps.title: Anchor Asset Creation
steps.description: Produce 1 comprehensive, high-value flagship asset (in-depth case study, teardown essay, or industry report).

breakdown.overview: Every distribution flywheel starts with an exceptional, comprehensive core piece of intellectual property.
keyActions: Conduct 4+ hours of primary source research and data synthesis.
Structure a 1,200 - 2,000 word deep-dive with proprietary frameworks and charts.
Get stakeholder sign-off on narrative accuracy and strategic claims.

toolsApplied.name: Google Docs / Notion
toolsApplied.purpose: Long-form research synthesis and collaborative editing

toolsApplied.name: Primary Source Library
toolsApplied.purpose: Compiling reports, financial data, and verified metrics

breakdown.decisionRule: You cannot distribute mediocre ideas. The anchor asset must be so valuable that readers bookmark and share it immediately.

steps.title: Short-Form Social Breakdowns
steps.description: Extract the 3 sharpest insights from the anchor piece into high-hook standalone social posts.

breakdown.overview: I break the anchor piece into 3 distinct, self-contained social posts optimized for feed engagement.
keyActions: Extract 3 standalone sub-lessons, each with its own tailored hook.
Format for LinkedIn with clean line spacing and bold takeaways.
Adapt the tone for Twitter/X with punchier sentences and threaded data.

toolsApplied.name: Platform Formatter
toolsApplied.purpose: Optimizing line breaks and character counts per platform

toolsApplied.name: Hook Testing Tool
toolsApplied.purpose: Scoring curiosity and hook retention

breakdown.decisionRule: Each derivative post must deliver complete value on its own without requiring the reader to click an external link.
breakdown.outputArtifact: 3-5 standalone LinkedIn and Twitter/X posts scheduled across the week.

steps.title: Visual Carousels & Infographics
steps.description: Convert complex processes and comparison charts into 5-8 slide visual PDF carousels that drive bookmarking.

breakdown.overview: Carousels generate the highest dwell time and save rates on professional feeds when formatted with crisp contrast.
keyActions: Translate textual frameworks into step-by-step visual slides.
Keep text under 25 words per slide for effortless mobile consumption.
Include a strong summary slide with a clear save-for-later callout.

toolsApplied.name: Napkin AI
toolsApplied.purpose: Instant flowchart and conceptual diagram generation

toolsApplied.name: Carousel Design Kit
toolsApplied.purpose: Exporting high-retention multi-slide assets

breakdown.decisionRule: Create once, distribute aggressively across formats. Different decision-makers consume information differently.
breakdown.outputArtifact: 10+ derivative promotional assets scheduled across platforms.

steps.title: Engagement Review & Iteration
steps.description: Track dwell time, comments, profile visits, and inbound leads to double down on winning hooks.

breakdown.overview: We measure real qualitative signals (founder comments, DM inquiries, newsletter signups) alongside raw impressions to evaluate true demand.
keyActions: Review post analytics after 48 hours to identify the top 20% performing hooks.
Tag inbound leads by the specific post or case study that brought them in.
Refine the next batch of content based on audience questions left in comments.

toolsApplied.name: Analytics Dashboard
toolsApplied.purpose: Tracking profile visits, conversions, and top hooks

toolsApplied.name: Comment Tagging Log
toolsApplied.purpose: Recording buyer objections for future posts

breakdown.decisionRule: Look past vanity likes. 5 comments from senior target executives are worth 5,000 random impressions.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Campaign Retrospective Report with next-cycle optimization notes.

frameworks.title: Content Operations & Systems
frameworks.tagline: Keeping publishing steady and organized without burning out
frameworks.summary: A simple Notion-based system to keep ideas, drafts, reviews, and published work in one clean place.

steps.title: Idea Backlog in Notion
steps.description: Maintain a centralized database of raw sparks, competitor notes, and audience questions so you never start from zero.

breakdown.overview: I build a streamlined Notion content engine that captures ideas instantly on mobile or desktop and organizes them by priority and pillar.
keyActions: Set up an Idea Capture inbox with quick tags for pillar, priority, and source link.
Categorize drafts by status: Idea -> Outline -> Draft -> Review -> Scheduled -> Published.
Maintain a swipe file of top-performing industry hooks and visual formats.

toolsApplied.name: Notion Relational Database
toolsApplied.purpose: Centralized idea bank with mobile capture widget

toolsApplied.name: Web Clipper
toolsApplied.purpose: Saving notable industry articles and data points on the fly

breakdown.decisionRule: Writer's block is a systems failure. A well-maintained idea backlog means you always sit down to write with clear momentum.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Operational Notion Content Database with custom Kanban views.

steps.title: Weekly Production Schedule
steps.description: Establish a weekly rhythm for research, drafting, reviewing, and publishing to eliminate last-minute rushes.

breakdown.overview: We implement a strict weekly cadence that separates deep creative writing from administrative scheduling.
keyActions: Monday: Signal detection, topic shortlisting, and outline approval.
Tuesday & Wednesday: Deep-focus drafting and visual diagram creation.
Thursday: Stakeholder review, fact-checking, and final out-loud polish.
Friday & Weekend: Scheduling and post-mortem review of the week's reach.

toolsApplied.name: Editorial Calendar
toolsApplied.purpose: Time-blocked production stages with clear owners

toolsApplied.name: Automated Reminders
toolsApplied.purpose: Notifying reviewers before deadlines

breakdown.decisionRule: Never research, draft, and publish on the same day. Batching by phase prevents creative fatigue and ensures consistent quality.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Weekly Editorial Calendar with locked deadlines.

steps.title: Pre-Publish Quality Check
steps.description: Run every draft through a strict editorial checklist before anything goes live.

breakdown.overview: Every post must pass a 3-point checklist before scheduling to maintain high editorial standards.
keyActions: Check 1 (Hook Quality): Does line 1 create curiosity without resorting to cheap clickbait?
Check 2 (Fact Integrity): Are all numbers, claims, and links verified against original sources?
Check 3 (Human Cadence): Does the copy sound natural when read out loud, with zero robotic jargon?

toolsApplied.name: Editorial QA Checklist
toolsApplied.purpose: Standardized 3-gate quality assessment

toolsApplied.name: Grammar & Rhythm Scanner
toolsApplied.purpose: Ensuring active voice and short paragraph lengths

breakdown.decisionRule: One bad post that sounds lazy or factually sloppy damages trust that took months to build.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Completed Quality Assurance Checklist for every scheduled post.

steps.title: Monthly Post-Mortem
steps.description: Analyze the top 3 and bottom 3 assets each month to isolate why specific hooks and narratives resonated.

breakdown.overview: At the end of every month, we conduct an analytical review of all published assets to find actionable patterns.
keyActions: Compare the top 3 and bottom 3 posts across impressions, engagements, and comments.
Analyze hook structure, visual type, and time-of-day variables.
Update the audience persona document with new objections and conversation topics discovered in comments.

toolsApplied.name: Monthly Performance Log
toolsApplied.purpose: Quantitative ranking of all published assets

toolsApplied.name: Retro Summary Sheet
toolsApplied.purpose: Documenting lessons for the next 30-day sprint

breakdown.decisionRule: Continuous improvement compounds. Small 5% improvements in hook clarity and structure turn average accounts into category leaders.
breakdown.outputArtifact: Monthly Editorial Retro Deck with data-backed adjustments.
